question: A patient with Stage 1 hypertension (BP 135/85 mmHg) and a 10-year ASCVD risk of 12% should be offered pharmacological antihypertensive therapy in addition to lifestyle modification.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is TRUE. ACC/AHA 2017 mandates pharmacotherapy for Stage 1 HTN (130–139/80–89 mmHg) when 10-year ASCVD risk ≥10%. With a risk of 12%, this patient qualifies for drug treatment — BP numbers alone do not determine the decision.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. ACC/AHA 2017 recommends pharmacotherapy for Stage 1 HTN when 10-year ASCVD risk is ≥10%. A risk of 12% exceeds this threshold, making drug therapy appropriate alongside lifestyle intervention.
